basic_info.headline: Systems Engineer with security depth | 24/7 platform operations, disaster recovery, automation | B.S. Information Security & Forensics
basic_info.about:
Systems engineer with security depth. For nearly a decade I engineered and operated core applications of a 24/7, mission-critical contact center platform at Fidelity Investments, then spent a year and a half in a Principal role supporting software and hardware solutions that improved associate and customer experiences.

What I do well:
- Incident Management. Root cause analysis using logs, configs, packet captures, and testing, working with stakeholders and vendors as needed.
- Automation. Ansible, Java, Shell, Batch, PowerShell, and Perl tooling for installs, upgrades, and health checks that alert the team.
- Change Management and Migrations. Application upgrades, config changes, firmware pushes, and more. I set the team standard for change tickets: clear summary, steps, and back-out. Completed two platform-wide migrations: a data center shutdown and an RHEL upgrade onto new VMs.
- Disaster Recovery & Risk Mitigation: I’ve written and exercised DR plans for critical platform apps to meet audits, and built automation that generates step-by-step DR plans.
- Documentation & Collaboration. I build detailed documentation and diagrams that make processes reproducible, and I promote knowledge sharing across teams. I’ve created knowledge bases in OneNote, Confluence, and SharePoint, used them to train and onboard new team members, and produced training guides, troubleshooting docs, and videos, including for the Softphone rollout.
- Communication. Managed multiple cross-domain projects, joined weekly change calls with Operations and business stakeholders, and was lead engineer on the Softphone rollout across the call center platform.

Security is where I started (B.S., Information Security and Forensics, RIT; information security internship), and I keep building breadth and depth through self-study and hands-on work in my home lab.

I actively utilize AI tools at work and at home for projects, troubleshooting, coding, and research, across frontier models (Gemini, Copilot/GPT, Claude) and self-hosted ones (Gemma, Muse Glimmer, Qwen, and others). I built and published a browser add-on for Firefox and Chrome.

Open to systems, infrastructure, SRE, and security engineering roles.
Hybrid around Nashua, the Merrimack Valley, and Boston, or remote or in-person.
matt@mwa.email

experience.title: Principal Systems Services And Support Analyst
experience.description:
Member of the Platform Enablement & Associate Experience Technology Team, driving the technical evolution of Fidelity's Investor Centers.

- Led a $2.5M conference room technology refresh across 100+ sites: set hardware standards, coordinated branches and the install vendor, reviewed proposals, approved invoices, and ran weekly meetings with real estate and validation teams.
- Chose the replacement strategy for legacy POTS fax lines (retire where unused, move the rest to a network-based provider with cellular backup, transparent for associates); estimated $750K in annual savings.
- Reviewed new technology against security and operational requirements: device network admission, permissions, data retention and privacy, SSO, logging, and success metrics.
- Covered a teammate's leave and took on projects: directed cellular signal scans and booster installs at Investor Centers, and took over EPOS headset vendor management (firmware update, headset testing, Softphone recommendations). Remained as a secondary for coverage and consulting upon teammates return.
- Built slide decks and tracked metrics for use briefing executives.
- Rotating on-call for workplace tools (EPOS, Yext, Glance); handled escalated incidents with user logs and vendor dashboards.
experience.position: Principal Systems Services And Support Analyst

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Engineer for the Call Center Platform, a many hats role. IT infrastructure, platform ops, and program leadership.  Genesys ecosystem, ITIL change management, cross-functional project delivery, mentoring and on-boarding, force multiplier promoting cross-team collaboration, and automation.

- Wrote DR plans for the Configuration Server and other applications, reviewed by my team and Operations, tested in non-Prod, and exercised in required production DR audits. Planned and ran a real after-hours UCS failover to the cold data center during a memory incident. Built automation that generates step-by-step DR plans.
- Performed two platform-wide migrations (data center decommission; RHEL VM refresh) w/ application cut-over plans and minimized downtime.
- Led the Genesys Softphone rollout for associates, replacing discontinued hardphones: user acceptance testing, sign-off from business and packaging teams, a phased rollout.
- Email Server SME: updated Java certificate stores and configured OAuth for Exchange mailboxes.
- Automation with Ansible, Java (Genesys SDK), PowerShell, Perl, Bash, and Windows Batch; health-check scripts raised alerts and notified the team. Monitoring with Splunk, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; packet capture with Wireshark.
- Weekly on-call rotation; escalation point for backend suppport of the platform.
- Onboarding new team members. New squad creation.
- SME for UCS, IxN, Chat, Email, Stat Server, ORS, Genesys Softphone, Config, related DBs, flexLM, Polycom Servers, and more.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description:
Engineer for the Call Center Platform, a many hats role.

- Continued to build technical skillsets and SME knowledge.
- SME for UCS, IxN, Chat, Email, Stat Server, ORS, Genesys Softphone, Config, related DBs, flexLM, Polycom Servers, and more.
- As a SME, investigated incidents hands on: UCS memory exhaustion, Config Server overload, and others. Commended for shared documentation that coordinated all teams.
- Refreshed certificates for the call center's Polycom phones through the internal certificate authority.
- Tested Genesys's clustered UCS in Dev; the upgrade was shelved when removed features had to be reintroduced with a single point of failure. Proposed and presented dedicated hardware for critical VMs (approved and purchased).

- Created a secure process for requesting, using, and returning encrypted flash drives
- Screening process for new systems requesting to be added to the network
- Helped test and review various projects to understand their security requirements and document any concerns, ex: email encryption.

projects.name: Defense Cybersecurity Home Lab Workshops
projects.description:
(self-study, in progress). Nine Labs diving into specific skills and technologies relating to Cybersecurity.
1. STIG RHEL9 (Scanning, manual and automated remediation, profile tailoring, building checklists)
2. STIG Windows Server (baseline and compliance scanning, importing DoD GPOs, verying policy)
3. Two-tier PKINBe (Running a root and issuing CA, certificate extensions, CRL and OCSP, deploying TLS)
4. Automated PKI and mTLS (ACME issuance and renewal, mutual TLS, comparing revocation models)
5. Key management (Shamir unsealing, key rotation and rewrap, least-privilege policies, audit logging, PKCS#11)
6. Data-at-rest-encrypition (LUKS2, TPM, and Tang binding, recovery testing, and key rotation)
7. Secure Boot and measured boot (Module sigining, MOK enrollment, reading PCRs and event logs, tamper testing)
8. RMF package (FIPS 199 categorization, control selection, SSP writing, assessment, POA&M, ATO memo, continuous monitoring plan)
9. Compliance pipeline (CI/CD workflows, Ansible roles, Molecule testing, image scanning and signing, signature-enforced deployment, compliance gates)

projects.name: Favorite Emotes Bar for YouTube Chat

Built with AI-assisted coding and security checks from the start: XSS protection, restricted emote domains, sanitized import/export, capped list sizes.

Continuing to maintain.
